Class Driver

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.core.Driver
public class Driver extends Object
Runs offscreen windows alongside Minecraft's normal client event loop.

Render-tick endings draw frames; client-tick endings update screens and synchronized sessions. Each window enforces its own frame-rate limit. Closing a window may remove it during iteration, so the registry permits that change. Its concurrent map does not authorize rendering or native calls off-thread.

    • onClientTick

      public void onClientTick(net.minecraftforge.fml.common.gameevent.TickEvent.ClientTickEvent event)
      Updates screens and sessions, closing all hosted state when the world ends. Sessions are released first on world exit so their framework bindings can clean up before remaining standalone windows are destroyed.
      Parameters:
      event - Forge client tick; START events are ignored

    • removeWindow

      public void removeWindow(Window window)
      Releases input ownership before forgetting a tracked window. This prevents held-key/button state from remaining assigned to a destroyed window.
      Parameters:
      window - window being destroyed; unknown IDs do nothing
